text.en: Dog owners express immense gratitude to groomers Audrey and Raquel for their kindness, patience, and attentive service. Reviewers note that the team takes time to understand each dog's specific needs, accommodating last-minute requests and maintaining high standards. Longtime patrons follow the groomers across locations due to their consistent personal dedication.

title.en: Patient care for special needs dogs

text.en: Clients frequently highlight how gently the groomers handle senior dogs, nervous rescues, and pets with chronic health conditions. Reviewers appreciate that animals with mobility issues or anxiety remain calm and relaxed throughout the grooming session. Pet parents note that their dogs return home happy and at ease rather than stressed by the visit.

Pet owners consistently praise the clean haircuts, soft coat finishes, and creative styling options such as mohawks and colourful trims. Reviewers mention that both large hairy dogs and smaller breeds look tidy and well-groomed upon collection. Customers also value the sanitary studio environment and thorough attention given to coat hygiene.

q.en: Does Fur Sure Grooming Studio accommodate senior or anxious dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently praise the team for patient and gentle handling of elderly pets and dogs with health conditions.

q.en: Do the groomers offer creative styling options?

a.en: Yes, clients mention custom haircut styles including mohawks, breed-specific cuts, and pet-safe colour accents.

q.en: Are the grooming facilities clean and sanitary?

a.en: Yes, pet parents note that the studio maintains a clean, modern, and hygienic grooming environment.
